e.title: insurance-conformal-fraud
e.summary: Conformal 欺诈检测（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：BH FDR 控制、集成 conformal 异常检测
e.summary_en: Conformal fraud detection (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): BH FDR control, integrated conformal anomaly detection
e.summary_hk: Conformal 欺詐檢測（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：BH FDR 控制、集成 conformal 異常檢測
e.body: insurance-conformal-fraud（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做索赔欺诈的 conformal 异常检测：BH（Benjamini-Hochberg）FDR 控制、集成 conformal 评分——欺诈标记的分布无关保证。对 RIAA：欺诈检测的统计保证——[[insurance-conformal]] 家族在欺诈场景的应用（异常 = 低 conformal 分数）；FDR 控制保证误报率可控（欺诈调查资源有限）；与公平性、治理（[[insurance-governance]]）配套；适合欺诈检测与异常检测方向。
e.body_en: insurance-conformal-fraud (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does conformal anomaly detection for claims fraud: BH (Benjamini-Hochberg) FDR control, integrated conformal scoring — distribution-free guarantees for fraud flagging. For RIAA: statistical guarantees for fraud detection — the [[insurance-conformal]] family applied to fraud (anomaly = low conformal score); FDR control bounds the false-positive rate (fraud investigation resources are limited); pairs with fairness and governance ([[insurance-governance]]); suits fraud and anomaly detection directions.
e.body_hk: insurance-conformal-fraud（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做索賠欺詐的 conformal 異常檢測：BH（Benjamini-Hochberg）FDR 控制、集成 conformal 評分——欺詐標記的分佈無關保證。對 RIAA：欺詐檢測的統計保證——[[insurance-conformal]] 家族在欺詐場景的應用（異常 = 低 conformal 分數）；FDR 控制保證誤報率可控（欺詐調查資源有限）；與公平性、治理（[[insurance-governance]]）配套；適合欺詐檢測與異常檢測方向。
